newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvian Unibanka eyes top investors for GDR.
newsitem.headline: Latvian Unibanka eyes top investors for GDR.

text.p: Latvian bank Unibanka hopes to attract the top 10 investment funds to its Global Depository Receipt (GDR) issue and thinks it will boost interest in Latvia as a whole, bank president Andris Berzinsh said on Thursday.

He declined to say how much the issue would be worth but expected it to happen before the end of the year. The issue will be arranged by Nomura, which has already carried out a GDR issue for top Lithuanian bank, Vilnius Bank.
"This move could attract top investors to Latvia. There are a number of companies which are interesting in investment terms in this country apart from Unibanka," Berzinsh told Reuters.
He said that Unibanka sees the GDR issue as a part of its planned capital boost. The aim is to double its share capital, currently at 26 million lats.
Unibanka would be the first Latvian commercial bank to make an international issue of its shares.
Berzinsh said he expected the price of Unibanka shares on the Latvian bourse, currently at 2.07 lats, to rise after the GDR issue.
He also said the GDR issue was a way of widening the bank's shareholder base and stabilising its share price in Latvia by having a clear reference on the world market.
